page.layout: Two printed columns side by side, left column then right column. Page number at top right. Running head at top of each column. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot of the right and left columns.

main_text.l: תִּיכוֹנָה[?] medianum, וּמֵהַתִּיכֹנוֹת[?] & ex medianis, No. f. m. & f. ut & pl. f. praef. à No. Rad. תָּוֶךְ medium.
תִּילִילוּ ejulabitis, Jef. 65. 14. pro תִּילִילוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. יָלַל
תֵּימָן auster, meridies, תֵּימָנָה versus meridiem, No. f. m. cum ה loc. à No. Rad. יָמִין dexter, ra, rum.
וַתִּינְקֵהוּ[?] & lactavisti, vel vit eum, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. R. יָנַק
תִּינָקִי suges, תִּינְקוּ sugetis, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָנַק
תְּיַסְּרֵנִי castiges, vel get me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָסַר
תִּיעֲשֶׂה fiet, Exod. 25. 31. (pro תֵּעָשֶׂה) fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. עָשָׂה
וַתִּיפִּי & pulchra fuisti, Ezech. 16. 13. fut. Kal, 2. f. f. R. יָפָה
וַתִּיקַר & exarsisti, vel sit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָקַר
תִּיקַר pretiosa fis, vel sit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָקַר
תִּירָא timebis, vel bit, תִּירְאוּ timebitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָרֵא
תִּירְשֶׁם[?] mustum eorum, No. f. m. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ possedit.
תִּירַשׁ possidebis, vel bit, תִּירְשׁוּ possidebitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fem. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
תְּיָשִׁים hirci, arietes, pl. m. No. Rad. תַּיִשׁ hircus, aries, caper.
תִּישְׁמֶנָה desolabimini, vel buntur[?], fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. יָשַׁם.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied from the scan at small size; forms marked [?] are doubtful. The word after "vel" in the entry "desolabimini" is blurred and uncertain. The entry "dormies, vel dormiet" is partly blotted. The running head is the Hebrew letter tav with geresh, printed on both pages. Ink spots and scan dust are not printed text and are omitted.
